claim_title: Raw milk reduces the severity of allergies
caption: **Raw milk and allergies.** The single reviewed source is a narrative review that summarises other studies but generates no new data and cannot prove cause and effect. The cited work tracks allergy incidence rather than severity, raw milk drinkers differ in many lifestyle ways, and one animal experiment actually showed an increased allergic response. There isn't enough evidence to support the claim.
subtitle: One narrative review measured allergy incidence, not severity, and proves no cause.
